summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 as a routine update on bitcoin purchases and share count. The company bought 18 bitcoin for ~$1.15M at $64,028 each, with no change to STRC Stock holdings. This is a periodic report of treasury operations, not a special situation transaction. The disclosure includes cash and equivalents of $154M and outstanding shares for Class A common, Class B common, and SATA Stock. No premium, board recommendation, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle applies; it is purely informational.
